measurements.definition: for each pattern, the share of council tax (VOA private count × band ratio × the authority's Band D) that a land tax at the rate balancing the two would move between cells, in points; nationally and per seat

measurements.survey_private_sector_rule: the unweighted mean of the survey's owner-occupier and private-renter means, moved to the basis by the UK HPI

social_values.rule: MVS 2024 AT1.3 regional all-social-renters mean, July 2024, moved to the calendar-2024 basis by the region's UK HPI all-dwellings index; Wales: England's social ÷ private-sector mean ratio × its own sales-based private mean

tenure.basis: Census 2021 TS054 by local authority: private-sector stock is all households less social rented; the owner-occupied share is owned outright plus owned with a mortgage over that private stock
tenure.rule: social homes per authority = VOA all properties × Census 2021 TS054 social rented share; spread over its MSOAs by each MSOA's count (the authority's share, uniformly)
